title: Report
description: A report the server generated for a site, as the report archive lists it. The recipients' e-mail addresses and the storage path are server-side and never part of this representation. Every property is present; absent values are null.

period_start.description: Shift report: the start of the shift. Daily, weekly, monthly: the site's local midnight that starts the first day of the period (a day's rounds are those of the windows starting on it, so they may run into the next morning).

period_end.description: Shift report: the end of the shift. Daily, weekly, monthly: the site's local midnight after the last day of the period (exclusive).

sent_at.description: When the e-mail went out; null until then.

download.description: The stored file of the report (the PDF of a weekly or monthly report) behind a signed, expiring URL that needs no token; null if the report has no stored file, or the data retention has deleted it.

url.description: Signed URL with the scheme and host of the API base; after expires_at it answers 403 forbidden, so list the reports again for a new one. The URL alone grants access, so it is https: http only if the API itself is served over http (local network development, never in production).
